The Artist Behind the Canvas → Full Page

"Art is how we tether fleeting moments of beauty to a lasting heirloom."

Based in the United Kingdom, Mishayam Rehman creates delicate, atmospheric fine art combining traditional oils, heavy gouache, watercolors, and genuine 24k gold leaf. Her work draws deep inspiration from ancestral heritage architecture, introspective emotional landscapes, and the untamed botanicals of the English countryside.

Every original painting, archival print, and hand-painted bookmark is crafted as a timeless treasure. Using 100% cotton acid-free Hahnemühle papers, lightfast museum-grade pigments, and hand-torn deckled edges, each piece is designed to bring stillness, warmth, and enduring luxury into your home.

Collector Care & Preservation

Art Care Instructions

"Each piece is made to be enjoyed for years to come. With a little care, you can help preserve the colour, finish, and details of your artwork."

Archival Editions

For the Oil Painting Prints

Fine Art Giclée

These prints are produced on premium matte Epson fine-art paper (I WILL DOUBLE CHECK IF THIS IS THE RIGHT NAME BUT ADD THIS FOR NOW), selected to beautifully reproduce the colours and details of my original oil paintings.

To help preserve your print:

Keep your print away from prolonged direct sunlight and strong UV exposure.
Display it in a cool, dry environment away from excessive humidity and moisture.
Handle the print with clean, dry hands, holding it by the edges whenever possible.
Avoid touching, rubbing, or scratching the printed surface.
For long-term display, consider framing your print behind UV-protective glass or acrylic.
When framing, archival and acid-free mounting materials are recommended.
When not on display, store your print flat in a clean, dry place, protected from light and moisture.
Handmade Originals

For the Original Acrylic-Painted Bookmarks

Varnished Acrylic Artwork

Each bookmark is individually hand-painted, making every piece a unique original work of art. The acrylic artwork is finished with a protective varnish to help protect the painted surface during normal use.

To keep your bookmark looking its best:

Keep it away from prolonged exposure to direct sunlight.
Avoid soaking or prolonged contact with water or moisture. The varnish provides protection, but the bookmark is not intended to be waterproof.
Handle gently and avoid bending, folding, or creasing the bookmark.
Avoid scratching or rubbing the painted surface against rough or sharp objects.
Store somewhere cool and dry when not in use.

Please treat your bookmark as a small piece of original artwork. With gentle handling and proper care, the painted finish can be enjoyed for a long time.

The Journey & Solace of Mishayam Rehman

"Art is how we tether fleeting moments of beauty, memory, and quiet stillness to a lasting heirloom."

Mishayam Rehman

United Kingdom Studio

Oil & Gold Leaf • Giclée Editions • Heirloom Keepsakes

Independent Studio Based in the UK

Every canvas crafted, varnished, and packaged by hand.

Blending Cultural Heritage with Introspective Solace

Welcome to the official atelier of Mishayam Rehman. Working from her light-filled studio in the United Kingdom, Mishayam creates rich, contemplative works in oil, heavy gouache, layered watercolor, and genuine 24k gold leaf. Her paintings exist as a bridge between ancestral architectural majesty and the quiet contemplation of contemporary life.

Her creative evolution was born out of a fascination with traditional arches, heritage courtyards, and ancient facades that have withstood centuries of rain, sun, and devotion. By incorporating real gilded leaf, she captures the shifting quality of sunlight across the day—ensuring each painting breathes with its environment.

Alongside architectural series, Mishayam explores intimate botanical sanctuaries inspired by wild English flora, as well as emotive figurative studies that invite the collector into moments of reflective stillness.

Mediums & Archival Craftsmanship

24k Genuine Gold Leaf

Hand-applied gilded foil layered over oil glazes, reflecting candlelight and shifting shadows naturally.

Hahnemühle 310gsm Paper

100% pure cotton rag archival paper meeting ISO 9706 museum conservation standards for 100+ years.

Hand-Torn Deckled Edges

Every print and original paper study is hand-feathered, giving collectors a tactile, timeless heirloom finish.

Signed & Embossed

Every piece is accompanied by a studio Certificate of Authenticity signed by Mishayam Rehman.

Collector Care Guide

How to Preserve & Frame Your Artwork

Framing & Glazing

Always request acid-free museum conservation mount boards and UV-filtering Artglass to preserve delicate watercolors, oils, and genuine 24k gold leaf from fading.

Placement & Lighting

Avoid hanging pieces in direct midday ultraviolet sunlight or near heating radiators and high-humidity bathrooms.

Handling Deckled Edges & Bookmarks

Always handle handmade deckled cotton rag paper by the outer borders with clean, dry hands.
